description: v2 parts bank: volume+role objects. Migrated v1 nouns + parametric volume families (ASSET_BANK_V2.md).

parts.name: ground
parts.summary: full-width static floor; the default ground plane games rest everything on

parts.name: platform_thin
parts.summary: thin static ledge for footholds and gaps; jump-clearance sized

parts.name: platform_wide
parts.summary: wide static platform/slab to stand a build on

parts.name: wall
parts.summary: tall static vertical barrier that contains the play area

parts.name: ledge
parts.summary: chunky static shelf/block to demolish onto or climb; sits proud of the floor

parts.name: ramp15
parts.summary: shallow ~15 deg static wedge; bodies roll/slide down it gently

parts.name: ramp30
parts.summary: steeper ~30 deg static wedge; faster roll/slide

parts.name: step_block
parts.summary: small static block to hop onto; height under the ~65px jump clearance

parts.name: crate_light
parts.summary: light wooden crate; stacks and topples, easy to push

parts.name: crate_heavy
parts.summary: heavy steel crate; resists pushing, good ballast for stacking

parts.name: ball_light
parts.summary: light rolling ball; nudged easily and carries momentum

parts.name: ball_dense
parts.summary: dense heavy ball; hits hard and is slow to deflect

parts.name: ball_bouncy
parts.summary: springy rubber ball; high restitution, bounces off surfaces

parts.name: barrel
parts.summary: upright drum/barrel; tips and rolls when struck

parts.name: plank
parts.summary: long thin board; leans, bridges gaps, or levers

parts.name: boulder
parts.summary: large heavy rock; crushes and rolls with big momentum

parts.name: puck
parts.summary: low-friction disc for ice/air-hockey games; glides and keeps momentum

parts.name: spike_strip
parts.summary: floor spike strip; a wide sensor the game reads as lethal on contact

parts.name: lava_pool
parts.summary: pool of lava; a wide sensor hazard, non-physical so bodies pass into it

parts.name: saw_disc
parts.summary: spinning saw blade; a circular sensor hazard read as lethal on contact

parts.name: spike_pit
parts.summary: wide floor-level spike pit; a broad sensor kill-zone to clear or avoid

parts.name: wrecking_ball
parts.summary: heavy ball on a rigid chain hung from a fixed anchor; swings as a pendulum

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: day2_wrecking crane+ball (r25, mass 10, pin at CoM, chain 270)

parts.name: pendulum
parts.summary: lighter bob on a short rigid chain; a compact swinging pendulum

parts.name: seesaw
parts.summary: plank balanced on a fixed fulcrum; tips when weight lands off-centre

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: hand-authored lever, pivot at plank centre of mass

parts.name: moving_platform_h
parts.summary: platform hung from an anchor and free to sway HORIZONTALLY (a flat trapeze); carries bodies as it swings. Continuous kinematic travel is deferred to the prompt/engine wave.

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: pendulum with a flat locked-rotation deck

parts.name: moving_platform_v
parts.summary: platform on a stiff damped spring above a fixed base; bobs VERTICALLY and settles, supporting light loads. Continuous kinematic travel is deferred to the prompt/engine wave.

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: damped spring tuned so default mass rests at spawn height

parts.name: goal_zone
parts.summary: goal region; a sensor that fires a contact when the target body enters

parts.name: pressure_zone
parts.summary: floor pressure pad; a low sensor that fires while a body stands on it

parts.name: checkpoint_zone
parts.summary: tall checkpoint gate; a sensor that marks a milestone as a body passes through

parts.name: target_zone
parts.summary: small target region; a compact sensor for aim/bounce goals

parts.name: ice_floor
parts.summary: very low-friction static floor; bodies slide across it and keep momentum

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: ground plane retuned to a near-frictionless ice sheet

parts.name: mud_patch
parts.summary: high-friction static patch; bodies stick and lose momentum crossing it

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: platform_wide retuned to a sticky mud surface

parts.name: bounce_pad
parts.summary: static springy pad; bodies landing on it rebound with high restitution

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: static ledge retuned to a high-restitution bounce surface

parts.name: ramp45
parts.summary: steep ~45 deg static wedge; bodies slide or roll down it fast

parts.name: pillar
parts.summary: tall narrow static column/pedestal to stand things on or gate a path

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: wall narrowed into a free-standing column

parts.name: bridge
parts.summary: long thin static bridge/board spanning a gap; a solid foothold over a pit

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: platform_thin lengthened into a static bridge span

parts.name: door_slab
parts.summary: static door panel that blocks a path; the game can world.remove() it to open the way

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: hand-authored static gate panel (removable in code)

parts.name: rolling_log
parts.summary: round wooden log that rolls when pushed and carries momentum

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: ball_light widened into a rolling log

parts.name: heavy_anvil
parts.summary: very heavy iron anvil; hard to shove, a strong ballast or crusher weight

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: crate_heavy scaled up into a dense anvil

parts.name: ice_block
parts.summary: slippery ice cube; a low-friction crate that slides far when pushed

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: crate_light retuned to a slippery ice cube

parts.name: block_tall
parts.summary: tall dynamic block for stacking towers; taller than wide, topples if unbalanced

parts.name: block_wide
parts.summary: wide dynamic block/lintel for stacking; a broad stable base or a beam to span

parts.name: marble
parts.summary: small dense marble; rolls fast and far, good for aim/roll puzzles

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: ball_light shrunk into a compact marble

parts.name: wedge_block
parts.summary: dynamic triangular wedge; stacks, ramps a body up, or wedges under a load

parts.name: water_pool
parts.summary: pool of deep water; a wide sensor hazard the game reads as drowning on contact

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: lava_pool recolored as a water hazard sensor

parts.name: fire_pit
parts.summary: bed of flames; a sensor hazard read as lethal on contact, bodies pass into it

parts.name: mine
parts.summary: round contact mine; a compact circular sensor hazard read as lethal on touch

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: saw_disc geometry reused as a contact mine sensor

parts.name: swing_gate
parts.summary: hinged flap hanging from a fixed top pivot; swings aside when a body pushes through

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: pendulum reshaped as a top-hinged swinging flap

parts.name: roller
parts.summary: free-spinning wheel on a fixed axle; a body crossing its top makes it turn

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: disc pinned at its centre to a static axle (revolute)

parts.name: hammer
parts.summary: heavy block head on a rigid arm hung from a fixed anchor; swings like a mallet

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: wrecking_ball with a rigid box head instead of a ball

parts.name: button_plate
parts.summary: flat floor button; a low sensor plate that fires while a body presses it

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: pressure_zone shrunk into a button plate

parts.name: lever_switch
parts.summary: upright lever switch; a tall sensor the game reads as flipped while a body contacts it

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: sensor switch in an upright lever footprint

parts.name: key_gem
parts.summary: collectible key/gem; a small sensor pickup that fires a contact when reached

parts.name: star_target
parts.summary: collectible star target; a small sensor to touch for aim/collect goals

provenance.author: harness-curated
provenance.calibrated_from: target_zone in a compact star pickup footprint
